steps.note: Wendell's call has gone through the switchboard (server_hall_warned): Asante will not talk, but the corrected figures left on the bench terminal earn one answer. The player then leaves her to it.

said: Somebody rang out through the switchboard and told the next shift to stay home. I've nothing to say to you.
Then you've read them. He thanked me and signed the old number anyway. That's all I'll say.
notSaid: You're the one off the office wall.
I wrote it. I'd write it again.
